notes: 8 lobes with painted pumpkin_dark groove strips (hard creased), bottom-heavy, curly stem_brown stem and a vine pig-tail tendril. Lobe panels show some faceting under studio light.
pumpkin_light with pumpkin_dark grooves, slight lean and twist, stem_green stem. Silhouette is a little barrel-like.
pumpkin_dark body with rust grooves, chunky stem. Grooves read weakly because the body is already dark.
Mini white pumpkin, green/white striped pear gourd, yellow crookneck, warty green gourd (olive warts). Crookneck is the weakest shape.
Boolean-carved recessed pockets: tapered pumpkin_dark walls frame inset glow_jack floors. Triangle eyes, wide crescent grin. socket_light at 0.19 m inside.
Triangle eye + carved ^ wink crescent, grin lifted on the wink side. Wink arc is the thinnest feature (about 5 cm).
Taller 0.56 m body, round eyes and an O mouth. Reads clearly.
Big grin with two square uncut teeth hanging from the upper lip, mouth floor glow_jack_hot, eyes glow_jack. Strongest read of the set.
Squat 0.38 m body, closed u-crescent eyes and small smile. Features are thinner than the others, so the read at 15 m and 35 degrees down depends on the emissive glow.

1.8 x 1.2 m, lopsided and leaning, flattened top (flat_top 0.82) for landing, big curly stem_green stem, pig-tail tendril, 2 leaves, pleated quilt_blue rosette with white ring, gold button and two tails that follow the surface. The stem sits near the centre of the walkable top.
1.1 x 0.6 x 0.55 m beveled box with a flat top, straw body, hay bevels, straw_dark cut ends, two rope bands, stubby straw tufts. Plain but a good platform.
Upright 1.2 x 1.0 m, rounded edges, straw_dark spiral strip on a flat top (sits 2 cm proud), a few wisps.

About 1.95 m. Burlap head, button eyes with glints, stitched smile, rosy cheeks, pumpkin nose, floppy straw hat tilted back with purple band and sunflower, plaid flannel shirt with patch, denim overalls with gold buttons and knee patch, straw at cuffs, arms on the crossbar. Close to budget (26 tris spare).
7 stalks pinched at a rope tie and splayed at the top, drooping straw/hay leaves. Still fairly thin and spiky-looking up close.

Long axis X, tongue toward -X. Bed floor top at 0.7 m (flat, flush plank seams), metal_red sides with white trim and X braces, 4 chunky charcoal wheels with red hubs, hay heap in back, small bale with a pumpkin on it and one more pumpkin. The hay heap is a low-poly ico and looks a little rocky.
Open wooden tray (wood_dark inside, light rim), one charcoal wheel at the front (-Y), handles and legs, three small pumpkins heaped in. Still a bit spindly for the toy style.
0.7 m cube, chamfered corner posts, two slats per side over a dark core, three flush top boards (flat landing), apple stamp on the front. Slats have no bevels because of the budget.
12-sided bulged lathe with alternating wood/plank staves, three iron hoops, recessed flat lid with plank seams (lid 3.5 cm below the rim).

2.45 m tall, 0.94 m head facing -Y and tilted 15 degrees down, two petal rings (sunflower_yellow plus golden_leaf), domed sunflower_center disc, green calyx, 4 big leaves. Stalk stays inside the 0.06 m trunk collider near its base.
Lumpy smooth mound (1.4 m, 0.4 m) in mixed leaf colours, 24 diamond chips and 3 maple stars spilling onto the ground. Some chips stand up at steep angles.
1.6 m, under 0.15 m high: 3 vine_dark vines, 3 tendril curls, 6 cupped lobed leaves (vine/hedge tops), 2 yellow blossoms. Leaves are 5-point star shapes, not true pumpkin-leaf outlines.
